deck_name: 08 - BS-CS-CPSE Phase 3: Control, Sensor Fusion, CAN, OPC UA & Edge AI

cards.prompt: What are the 3 terms of a discrete PID controller and what error behavior does each address?
cards.answer: Proportional (present error), Integral (accumulated past steady-state error), Derivative (predicted future rate of error change / damping)
accepted_answers: Proportional (present error), Integral (accumulated past steady-state error), Derivative (predicted future rate of error change / damping)
cards.explanation: P drives response speed, I eliminates steady-state offset, and D dampens overshoot and oscillation.

cards.prompt: What PID failure mode happens when the actuator saturates (e.g., 100% PWM) while the Integral term keeps accumulating large error, causing massive overshoot?
cards.explanation: Mitigated via integrator clamping, back-calculation, or conditional integration when the actuator is saturated.

cards.prompt: Why should the Derivative (D) term in a digital PID controller usually be paired with a low-pass filter or computed on measurement (-dPV/dt)?
cards.answer: High-frequency sensor noise gets amplified by differentiation, and setpoint step changes cause derivative kick
accepted_answers: High-frequency sensor noise gets amplified by differentiation, and setpoint step changes cause derivative kick
To prevent high-frequency noise amplification and derivative kick
cards.explanation: Taking -d(measurement)/dt eliminates derivative kick on sudden setpoint changes, while a first-order IIR filter tames sensor noise.

cards.prompt: According to the Nyquist-Shannon Sampling Theorem, what is the minimum sampling rate fs required to capture a signal with maximum frequency fmax without aliasing?
accepted_answers: More than twice the highest frequency
cards.explanation: In practical control systems, engineers typically sample at 10x to 20x the closed-loop bandwidth.

cards.prompt: What are the 2 recurring steps of a Kalman Filter / Extended Kalman Filter (EKF)?
cards.answer: 1) Predict (Time Update using motion model & process noise Q); 2) Update / Correct (Measurement Update using sensor reading & noise R)
accepted_answers: 1) Predict (Time Update using motion model & process noise Q); 2) Update / Correct (Measurement Update using sensor reading & noise R)
cards.explanation: The EKF linearizes nonlinear dynamics and measurement equations around the current state estimate using Jacobian matrices.

cards.prompt: Why do 3D robotics and IMU orientation pipelines prefer Unit Quaternions over Euler Angles (Roll, Pitch, Yaw)?
cards.answer: Quaternions avoid Gimbal Lock singularities and compose rotations smoothly with faster, drift-free normalization
accepted_answers: Quaternions avoid Gimbal Lock singularities and compose rotations smoothly with faster, drift-free normalization
cards.explanation: Euler angles lose a degree of freedom when pitch hits +/- 90 degrees (Gimbal Lock).

cards.prompt: How does CAN 2.0B resolve bus collisions when two nodes transmit simultaneously without losing any frames or throughput?
cards.answer: Non-destructive bitwise arbitration where dominant '0' bits overwrite recessive '1' bits (lower CAN ID wins)
accepted_answers: Non-destructive bitwise arbitration where dominant '0' bits overwrite recessive '1' bits (lower CAN ID wins)
cards.explanation: Each node monitors the bus while transmitting its 11-bit or 29-bit ID; if it sends a recessive 1 and reads a dominant 0, it immediately backs off into receive mode.

cards.prompt: What is the maximum data payload size in bytes of a classic CAN 2.0B frame vs. a CAN FD frame?
cards.explanation: CAN FD also allows switching to a higher data-phase bit rate after the arbitration field.

cards.prompt: What is the standard termination resistance placed at each physical end of a CAN bus twisted pair (CAN_H / CAN_L)?
cards.answer: 120 ohms at each end (60 ohms measured across the bus)
accepted_answers: 120 ohms at each end (60 ohms measured across the bus)
cards.explanation: Matches the 120-ohm characteristic impedance of the twisted-pair cable to prevent signal reflections.

cards.prompt: What are the 3 sequential stages of a deterministic PLC / IEC 61131-3 Programmable Automation Controller (PAC) scan cycle?
cards.answer: 1) Read Physical Inputs -> 2) Execute Control Logic Program -> 3) Write Physical Outputs
accepted_answers: 1) Read Physical Inputs -> 2) Execute Control Logic Program -> 3) Write Physical Outputs
Read Inputs, Execute Logic, Write Outputs
cards.explanation: Freezing an input image table at the start of the scan guarantees inputs do not change mid-rung during logic evaluation.

cards.prompt: What industrial interoperability protocol (IEC 62541, implemented in C via open62541) provides hierarchical information modeling, pub/sub, and built-in X.509 security?
cards.explanation: OPC UA replaces legacy Windows-only OPC Classic with a cross-platform, self-describing node graph for smart factories.

cards.prompt: What does INT8 post-training quantization do to an ONNX / TensorRT neural network model for edge deployment?
cards.answer: Converts 32-bit floating-point weights/activations to 8-bit integers, cutting memory footprint ~4x and accelerating Tensor Core inference
accepted_answers: Converts 32-bit floating-point weights/activations to 8-bit integers, cutting memory footprint ~4x and accelerating Tensor Core inference
Maps FP32 weights and activations to 8-bit integers for faster, smaller inference
Reduces precision from FP32 to INT8
cards.explanation: Requires a representative calibration dataset to minimize accuracy drop when scaling activation ranges.

cards.prompt: In a 30 FPS closed-loop vision tracking turret, what is the maximum total frame period budget in milliseconds?
cards.explanation: 1000 ms / 30 frames = 33.33 ms; keeping glass-to-glass latency under 35 ms prevents phase-lag oscillation in the gimbal.
